recipes.name: Caramelized Onion & Balsamic Hummus
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat*. Cook the onions until deeply golden, about 20 minutes. Stir occasionally and add splashes of water as needed to deglaze the pan.
Place the caramelized onions in a food processor, along with all the remaining ingredients. Blend on high until smooth.
Test test and adjust the seasoning as desired. Serve with crackers, cut-up vegetables, or enjoy in a wrap or sandwich!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * Depending on the pan, you made need to reduce the heat to medium, but this will also increase the cooking time.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.
